message.content: Well, I've been short of breath and coughing for about two weeks now. They drained the fluid from my right chest and took off about a liter and a half. It looked milky, which the doctor said was odd. I felt better for a little while, but then the breathlessness came back and I had to return to the ER a few days later. I'm not sure what caused the fluid. As for how bad it is now, it feels about as bad as before the drainage, maybe getting worse again. I haven't had any injury to my chest or any surgery recently. I also have a long smoking history, about 45 pack-years.
